kurz: On a very hot pan, a drop of water floats on its own cushion of steam and dances around.
bild_im_kopf: Like an air hockey puck on a cushion of air.
was_passiert: At medium heat a drop evaporates with a hiss. If the pan is much hotter, the underside evaporates so fast that a cushion of steam forms and the drop glides on it. It even lasts longer.
warum_wichtig: The simplest test of whether a stainless steel pan is hot enough for meat or fish.
faustregeln: Stainless steel pan: when a drop of water dances as a ball, it is hot enough for nothing to stick.
Do not overheat non-stick pans while empty.
